prompt: GraphQL FieldSelectionMap SelectedListValue elements allowed difference ListValue
answer:
`SelectedListValue` differs from GraphQL’s `ListValue` in that each list element may contain only one `SelectedValue`.

- **`SelectedListValue`**: an ordered list of `SelectedValue` elements, used to express equivalence between a list argument and values selected from a list field. It does **not** allow multiple `SelectedValue` elements within one list element.
- **`ListValue`**: a general GraphQL input list whose `[Valuelist]` may contain multiple values.

Thus, `parts[id]` is valid, while `parts[id, name]` is invalid as a `SelectedListValue`. A `SelectedObjectValue` may be used as one element when selecting multiple fields from structurally equivalent objects. (Source: [Field Selection specification](https://github.com/graphql/composite-schemas-spec/blob/main/spec/Appendix%20A%20--%20Field%20Selection.md); [GraphQL specification](https://spec.graphql.org/September2025))
